source: Three user-supplied photographs of the Passaporte para Português glossary, entries abaixo–aprender
word_policy: Individual lowercase NFC-normalized words only; source expressions and references retained in extracted JSON.
normalization_notes: Manually transcribed all readable glossary entries, including unhighlighted entries; no running prose or headings imported.
The main columns contain 99 row occurrences. Sugar and goodbye overlap between photos 1 and 2. Repeated acontecer/acordar fragments at the very top of photo 2 are not counted again.
Printed numeric/P references are source metadata, not CEFR levels or SQLite categories.
Lowercase and NFC normalize; remove punctuation and trailing noun-gender articles; split expressions into individual words.

Retain actual component words in illustrative phrases (escola, carro, fato); remove generic fazer algo/etwas placeholders from acabar de and algo from andar a fazer algo. Fazer and algo independently occur elsewhere.
Split apaixonar-se into verb apaixonar and reflexive pronoun se. Preserve the complete expression and its reflexive meaning in source/context metadata.
Keep inflected words such as anos, viagens, média, física and naquela distinct rather than generating additional lemmas.
Preserve German translations exactly as readable source data; translate individual Portuguese words independently. Idiom glosses are not word-for-word meanings.
The last photographed row, aprender (reference 20, lernen), is readable; the next page header has no readable word entries.

enrichment.translations: Existing English/Ukrainian translations retained exactly. New translations supplied by assistant, not printed in the photos.
enrichment.levels: Existing levels retained exactly. A1/A2 levels for new entries are assistant estimates, not source-provided assessments.
enrichment.groups: Existing thematic/grammatical categories reused; no source categories created.

dictionary_checks.note: Dictionary distinguishes transitive inspiring passion/love from pronominal falling in love. The separated verb card explicitly labels the -se sense.

contextual_meaning_gaps.action: Preserve existing walking/going translation and record the noun sense here; do not assign Accommodation based on an unstored sense.

source_gloss_notes: por acaso has an idiomatic German gloss in the photo; acaso is translated independently as chance/coincidence.
aparência física is split; física is the feminine adjective physical, not the noun physics.
New words receive mastery 0; existing IDs, translations, levels, mastery, sessions and answers are preserved.
